pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: for Gaya Nalanda show registered pregnancy based rates for delivery and postnatal, 2022 to 2023
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered, institutional_deliveries, postnatal_check_48h FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2023), delivery_rate AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered / NULLIF(NULLIF(institutional_deliveries, 0), 0) AS delivery_rate FROM rates), postnatal_rate AS (SELECT district, year, postnatal_check_48h / NULLIF(NULLIF(institutional_deliveries, 0), 0) AS postnatal_rate FROM rates) SELECT delivery_rate.district, delivery_rate.year, delivery_rate.delivery_rate, postnatal_rate.postnatal_rate FROM delivery_rate JOIN postnatal_rate ON delivery_rate.district = postnatal_rate.district AND delivery_rate.year = postnatal_rate.year

WITH 
  rates AS (
    SELECT 
      district, 
      year, 
      pregnancies_registered, 
      institutional_deliveries, 
      postnatal_check_48h 
    FROM 
      maternal_services 
    WHERE 
      district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') 
      AND year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2023
  ),
  delivery_rate AS (
    SELECT 
      district, 
      year, 
      pregnancies_registered / NULLIF(institutional_deliveries, 0) AS delivery_rate 
    FROM 
      rates
  ),
  postnatal_rate AS (
    SELECT 
      district, 
      year, 
      postnatal_check_48h / NULLIF(institutional_deliveries, 0) AS postnatal_rate 
    FROM 
      rates
  )
SELECT 
  delivery_rate.district, 
  delivery_rate.year, 
  delivery_rate.delivery_rate, 
  postnatal_rate.postnatal_rate 
FROM 
  delivery_rate 
  JOIN 
  postnatal_rate ON delivery_rate.district = postnatal_rate.district AND delivery_rate.year = postnatal_rate.year
